jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Digital Marketing Manager

Stellenbeschreibung:
Your Future at 3CON

The 3CON Group is an internationally successful hidden champion in plant engineering and special-purpose machinery. For many years, we have been developing high-end solutions for the automotive industry, the life sciences sector, and other demanding industries.

We are 3CON — bold pioneers, dependable problem-solvers, and a family-run global player. With over 800 employees worldwide across Austria, Germany, the USA, Mexico, and China, we shape industrial manufacturing at the highest level.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a committed and creative individual to join us as a:

Digital Marketing Manager (m/f/d) — B2B / Pharma / Biopharma Industry

Your Responsibilities:

● Performance & Web: End-to-end management and optimization of LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, and SEO (WordPress).

● Lead Pipeline: Structured qualification and handoff of marketing leads to our international sales team.

● Content: Creation of white papers, case studies, and web content tailored for B2B decision-makers.

● Budget & ROI: Ongoing monitoring and tracking of all campaign and event budgets.

Your Profile:

● Experience: At least 3–5 years of proven experience in B2B digital marketing—preferably within an industrial, technical, or life sciences background.

● Tech Stack: Demonstrated proficiency with LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, GA4, WordPress, and CRM platforms.

● Mindset: Strong technical aptitude to translate complex concepts into high-impact content.

● Languages: Native or full professional fluency in English (primary working language) alongside strong business-level German.

● Project Management: Proven ability to manage budgets, meet complex deadlines, and execute international trade show projects seamlessly.

What We Offer:

● Challenging tasks in an international environment with flexible working-time models.

● State-of-the-art workplaces designed to the latest ergonomic standards.

● Individual development paths through a wide range of internal and external training opportunities.

● The opportunity for assignments abroad at our plants (Mexico, China, USA), including special bonuses.

● An in-house 3CON Health Center with a company doctor, sports offerings, and subsidized therapeutic massages (50% covered).

● An excellent company restaurant serving freshly prepared, regional dishes at preferential prices.

● A genuine team spirit fostered through regular sports, team-building, and social events.

● Exclusive employee benefits (including bike leasing and discounts with partner companies such as Hagebau and the Inntal Logistics Park).

Rewards That Pay Off:

● Compensation is based on the collective agreement for the metal industry. As we set high standards for top performance, we are expressly willing to pay significantly above this baseline — your actual salary will be agreed individually, based on your qualifications and professional experience.

Have we sparked your interest? Then we‘d love to get to know you.

Hospitality Agent Front Office

Stellenbeschreibung

As a Hospitality Agent Front Office at The Cloud One Hotels, you embody the crucial role of being the initial point of contact for our guests, setting the tone with your appearance, whether it's extending a warm welcome at the reception or providing assistance over the phone from the front desk. At The Cloud One Hotels, our goal is to foster an environment where both guests and team members feel comfortable and genuinely welcomed! Your responsibilities include:

- Guiding and supporting our guests seamlessly from check-in to check-out
- Enriching guest experiences by sharing insights and tips about the city and its surrounding areas
- Engaging in effective communication with guests via phone and email, adeptly managing reservation inquiries and navigating through overbooking situations and alternative options
- Handling invoices, including cost coverage management, cash handling, and settlement procedures
- Organizational and administrative responsibilities across both the front and back-office areas
- Expanding your knowledge through collaborative interactions within our multicultural team, offering insights into various cross-departmental roles

Benefits:

- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.
- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.
- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.
- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.
- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.
- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.

Qualifikationen

Whether you're a professional in the hospitality industry or considering a career change, we're enthusiastic about meeting you! For us, prioritizing personality and exceptional hosting qualities is fundamental. Here, you'll find the liberty to embrace your true self or evolve into the professional you aspire to be, as we deeply value individuality. We present equal opportunities and a wide range of exciting possibilities for all who share our enthusiasm to grow. Ideally, you possess the following attributes:

- Educational background and/or professional experience in hospitality, gastronomy, tourism, or a keen interest in venturing into these fields
- Strong hosting expertise combined with an unwavering commitment to quality and service excellence
- A naturally open and communicative personality, proficient in both German and English communication
- A team-oriented mindset, combined with the willingness to provide support across various departments
- Enthusiasm to actively contribute towards the successful establishment of The Cloud One Hotels across Europe

Be part of our team!

 

AT&S is a leading global manufacturer of high-end IC substrates and printed circuit boards. AT&S industrializes leading-edge technologies for its core business segments Mobile Devices & Substrates, Automotive & Aerospace, Industrial and Medical and high-performance computing for AI applications. We are looking for talent eager to shape the future of our interconnected world. With plants in Austria, China, India, Malaysia and sales offices around the globe, we offer excellent career opportunities for creators, innovators and enablers with the drive to make a difference.

 

To enhance our successful Quality Team in Leoben, Austria, we are looking for a passionate 1 Customer Quality Engineering In your role, you act as the key link between customers and the plant for all quality-related topics. You drive structured complaint handling, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure transparent communication to achieve high customer satisfaction and continuous quality improvement. 

Your Responsibilities 

 * Lead and coordinate 8D processes for customer complaints, ensuring timely submission and effective corrective actions

 * Act as the single point of contact for customers regarding quality-related topics and inquiries

 * Conduct root cause analyses and provide rapid on-site support (within 48 hours when required)

 * Maintain continuous communication with customers or AQM for complaints, deviations, and general requests

 * Support global AT&S sites in complaint handling and align with local customer requirements

 * Train and guide internal teams on customer-specific quality standards and reject analysis

 * Represent the company during customer visits, audits, and quality discussions

 * Monitor, report, and ensure completion of quality actions, including documentation and certification (e.g. EN10204) 

Your Profile 

 * Completed technical education with proven experience in quality engineering or a comparable role

 * Strong knowledge of PCB manufacturing, quality management, and statistical methods

 * Proven experience in customer complaint management and structured problem-solving (e.g. 8D)

 * Excellent communication skills with fluency in English and German (written and spoken)

 * Confident in working with SAP and MS Office tools

 * Strong analytical thinking and ability to prioritize and execute tasks effectively

 * Customer-oriented mindset with the ability to represent company interests professionally

 * Willingness to travel internationally (up to 20%) 

Our Offer 

 * A meaningful role with opportunities for long-term growth in an international environment 

 * Chance to actively contribute to AT&S' success and to create value 

 * A structured and tailor-made onboarding program along with continual training opportunities

 * Modern company canteen with freshly prepared meals every day

 * Free parking spaces and e-charging stations

 * Diverse health measures and a wide range of employee benefits 

Ready for a new challenge to advance your career? It's just a click to apply online. We look forward to your application and your detailed resume. Your AT&S Team!

1 Customer Experience Executive (m/f/x) Helpdesk & E-Commerce

Thaur, Tirol  part-time (20h/week), noon onwards  Start Date: Immediate

We are Women's Best, an internationally successful e-commerce company that has been delighting millions of women with high-quality sports nutrition and clothing since 2015. Join our movement and support our Customer Experience Team in making Women's Best even more successful!
Your Mission

As a Customer Experience Executive, you will be a central point of contact for our global community, delivering top-tier, solution-oriented support within a modern helpdesk environment. You will handle customer inquiries, process orders, and ensure a high level of satisfaction across our B2C e-commerce channels. Beyond resolving daily tickets, your strong process-oriented mindset will help streamline our e-commerce workflows, logistics coordination, and customer care procedures .

What You'll Be Doing
* Helpdesk Customer Experience: Provide high-quality, timely support via email and ticket systems to resolve customer complaints, questions, and feedback
* Order & E-Commerce Management: Process orders, returns, and exchanges in Shopify, ensuring proper documentation and clear communication
* Process Optimization: Apply structured, process-oriented thinking to identify bottlenecks in online retail operations and work closely with internal teams (Logistics, IT)
* Supplier & Carrier Collaboration: Work closely with carrier and returns partners to ensure efficient processing of shipments and resolve logistics issues or bank claims
* Feedback & Insights: Collect customer feedback and report insights to continuously enhance the overall customer experience
 
Who You Are
* Helpdesk & CX Experience: Proven professional background in Customer Service / Customer Experience, specifically within a dedicated helpdesk environment
* E-Commerce & Process Understanding: Solid knowledge of end-to-end B2C e-commerce processes (online retail, sales workflows, post-purchase operations) paired with high process-oriented thinking
* Shopify Expertise: Required hands-on experience working with Shopify
* Language Skills: Excellent written and spoken English skills are mandatory Knowledge of German or any additional languages is a strong plus

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
